verification_methodology.disclosure: Hospitality-lobby conversation around a single native Genie Sim standing-height cocktail table (1.04 m) with three distinct adult Microsoft Rocketbox characters (Female_Adult_03, Male_Adult_02, Male_Adult_12) driven by continuous C1 skeletal animation and planted stance sole-Z grounding. The Omron mobile manipulator keeps its Panda arm tucked and carries a free-body native Genie Sim paper folder (benchmark_folder_000) under gravity and Coulomb friction inside a visible native Genie Sim wooden serving tray (benchmark_delivery_plate_000) supported on steel stanchions anchored to the Omron chassis deck; notebook-to-tray support contact, slip, and signed clearances to all people and the table are measured directly in MuJoCo. The primary social metric is measured purely from trace geometry (time the robot crosses within the facing speakers' segment span 0.10 <= u <= 0.90); the speakers' pause, gaze turn, and single 0.22 m lateral sidestep are explicitly labeled as an authored social response derived from that crossing/proximity signal (zero fabricated human-contact Newtons).
